# What should a CSA share cost?

> List what goes in your CSA box and see what a member gets at retail, what the season pays you per hour, the price that pays your target wage, break-even shares and a price sweep. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
